doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The trio as her current writing focus
summary: The trio with Andy Sheppard and Steve Swallow is all she writes for now and works only outside the United States because of visa difficulty.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: [Laughs] You know, anything’s possible. The other areas I quickly wanted to talk about is that - we talked briefly about it - the duo and trio. And I love the trio with Andy Sheppard, you, Steve. That to me is a very creative music moment that’s happening there.
That’s continuing. That’s all I’m writing for now is the trio.
Ok. And Andy is the reed player, there’s nobody else that subs for him.
Ok. So it’s a defined unit that either that unit goes out or it’s not happening at
I know. We can’t play in the states because getting him over here with a visa would be too hard. We did it once and it was months of paperwork and cost, so we only work in other countries.
